css.description: The main color of the element's `data-ok-color`, as RGB channels.
css.name: --ok-c-channel

css.description: The main color of the element's `data-ok-color`.
css.name: --ok-c-main

options.description: Color when checked or indeterminate (`default` = text color).
options.name: color

options.description: Mixed state: shows a dash and sets the input's `indeterminate` (`aria-checked=mixed`).
options.name: indeterminate

options.description: Color swatches only (`swatch`): a circle or a square with rounded corners.
options.name: shape

parts.description: The default icons' box, drawn by the stylesheet (filled when checked or indeterminate).
parts.name: data-ok-checkbox-box

parts.description: The icon of one state. The checkbox shows the one that matches.
parts.name: data-ok-checkbox-icon

parts.description: The native checkbox. It covers the control, invisible, and takes `name`, `value`, `checked`, `disabled` and `required`.
parts.name: data-ok-checkbox-input

parts.description: The mark inside the box of the checked and indeterminate icons: a check or a dash.
parts.name: data-ok-checkbox-mark

parts.description: A color swatch, instead of the icons (with `data-ok-swatch`). It holds the check mark shown while checked.
parts.name: data-ok-checkbox-swatch

parts.description: A color swatch's color: a CSS color, such as `#FF9800`, or a `var(--ok-…)` token. Other values are ignored (the swatch stays grey).
parts.name: data-ok-swatch

react.description: A native `<input type="checkbox">` with themed icons; `ref` and the remaining props go to the input. Name it with a `FormControlLabel`, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.

props.description: Replaces the checked icon (with `swatch`: the mark on the checked swatch).
props.name: checkedIcon

props.description: Class of the root span (other props go to the input).
props.name: className

props.description: Color when checked or indeterminate; `default` is the text color.
props.name: color

props.description: Mixed state: shows a dash and sets the input's `indeterminate`.
props.name: indeterminate

props.description: Called with the new checked state.
props.name: onChange

props.description: Shows a color swatch instead of the icons (a color picker): a CSS color, such as `#FF9800`, or a `var(--ok-…)` token. Name the checkbox with the color's name (`aria-label="Orange"`).
props.name: swatch
